build_kserve_inference_client: build a synchronous Python client for KServe v2 REST inference endpoints that sends numpy arrays and receives numpy arrays
run_inference_request: run an inference request against a KServe v2 endpoint with input tensors and return decoded numpy output arrays
get_model_metadata: get model metadata from a KServe v2 endpoint including input and output schema information
encode_input_tensor: encode a numpy array into KServe v2 JSON input tensor format with name, shape, datatype, and flattened data
decode_output_tensor: decode a KServe v2 JSON output tensor response back into a numpy array with the original shape and dtype
